title_o: Implicit attitude generalization occurs immediately; explicit attitude generalization takes time
verdict_reason: impex_final_dataset.csv (osf.io/8tzep) has 4267 rows, 3597 after the script's four exclusions; the implicit (IAT) Welch t-test by rateorig gives t(3511)=-6.31, p=3.2e-10, d about .21, matching N, p (~0) and d=.21 in the table and report.

data_files.notes: processed per-participant file: exppref, imppref, d, fastpct10, alltrials, rateorig
88.6 MB raw IAT trials; not downloaded (final dataset suffices; under the 150 MB cap)

key_test.test: Welch t-test of implicit preference imppref by rateorig (original vs new pair); the script also runs the explicit test exppref (t=-22.8), the table's d=.21 matches the implicit test

recompute.method: ran the R script (Hmisc/psych describe lines removed; not needed for the statistic)

obstacles: script reports two tests and prints the explicit one first; the implicit one is the key, confirmed by description and d=.21
effect size not computed by the script
final dataset derived from raw txt files by prep_dataset.R / iatscoring.R (not re-run)
